## Must-haves
The twelve registered blocks in D 6.2 order with `is_default` values so a fresh install renders the full home from `defaults.ts`; the hero image is the LCP element with `fetchpriority="high"`, explicit width and height, no blur; goal tiles link by slug through `content/goals.ts` (fallback `/search?q=`); category tiles from the merchant's selection or the ten type slugs; products block through `ProductsSliderWrapper` on `latest`; services band on `.ox-band-dark` with one wedge; guides hidden under three articles; branch block reuses `OxBranch` with `headingLevel` h2; FAQ includes the mandatory price item; newsletter hidden unless `show_newsletter`; the sr-only h1 rule when no hero block. Claims gates: `{threshold}` from `free_shipping_threshold`; payment marks via `SallaPayments` only; reply time only with `reply_sla_hours`; distributor line only with `claim_official_distributors`.
